content.short: Dotare is a Cardano-based decentralized endowment for universal basic income and direct support programs.
content.description: Dotare is a decentralized endowment project for delivering global universal basic income through Cardano and cryptocurrency rails. The platform is designed to let benefactors support beneficiaries directly, using blockchain technology to create a more inclusive, sustainable, and privacy-respecting financial foundation. Instead of acting like a normal exchange, Dotare focuses on social funding, recurring support, and global access. Its Cardano role is to apply decentralized finance ideas to direct human assistance.
content.meta: Dotare uses Cardano to support a decentralized endowment for universal basic income programs. Explore Dotare on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
